notes.title: Pokémon adventure — shared art style and prompt menu feedback
notes.text: Choose Artwork or Sprite in Pokémon Settings → Appearance → Pokémon art style. The existing character preference applies to all Pokémon menu portraits: starter choices, party and owned/reference details, storage, Pokédex/forms, journey, service and Sandbox pickers, quests, battle menus, companion panels and addon character creation/review. Owned images preserve Shiny/gender/form selection; the battle field keeps its directional actors. Training and Nickname controls have separate spacing. The replacement user-provided menu sample is trimmed and decoded ahead of clicks, with browser fallback.
